archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) with an Academic/Editorial twist

admin_dashboard.surface_style: cardless, crisp 1px borders, p-6, no shadow, bg-white

student_portal.surface_style: bg-white shadow-sm border border-stone-200 p-8 md:p-12

components.strategy: Shadcn UI customized heavily for high-density academic data
components.tables: Dense, monospace font for numbers, sticky headers, text-sm, hover:bg-stone-50. Emphasize row highlighting for students with * subjects.
components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm. High contrast. Primary uses indigo-950.
components.inputs: Square or rounded-sm. Focus ring uses indigo-950.
components.badges: For * subjects (backlogs), use amber/yellow muted background with dark amber text and 1px border. For regular subjects, use stone-100.
components.tabs: Underline style, no pills. border-b-2 border-transparent data-[state=active]:border-indigo-950.

motion.student: Staggered fade-up (Framer Motion) for semester results to create a deliberate, official 'unveiling' feel.
motion.hover: Subtle background shifts, no heavy scaling.

images.description: Modern university campus building used for the student portal login page background. MUST be overlaid with bg-stone-900/60 for text contrast.
Tree-lined campus walkway. Use in grayscale (grayscale class) and low opacity (opacity-20) as an empty state illustration for the admin file center.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactable elements MUST have data-testid. e.g., data-testid='admin-login-button', data-testid='upload-tc-btn', data-testid='student-search-input'.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure black/dark grey on white for all data. Badges must pass 4.5:1 ratio.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono, Playfair Display.
Configure Tailwind with the provided color scheme, mapping stone colors to the default grey/border variables.
Implement two separate layouts/routes: /admin (Dashboard, Data-heavy, side nav) and /student (Centered login, Transcript view).
For the Admin Upload Center, use Shadcn forms with custom dropzones for PDF and Excel.

For the Student Result view, design it like an official academic transcript: Serif headers for the University Name, mono for grades, with amber highlight badges for subjects containing the '*' marker.
Never use generic placeholder images. Use the provided Pexels university images.
Always use the 'data-testid' attributes for testing.
